meta.description: Parses visitor's preferred time, checks Calendly availability, creates one-time booking link, saves appointment to Supabase, sends confirmation email.

_setupNotes.CALENDLY_API_TOKEN: Get from Calendly → Integrations → API → Personal Access Tokens
_setupNotes.CALENDLY_USER_URI: Your Calendly user URI — get from GET https://api.calendly.com/users/me after auth
_setupNotes.CALENDLY_BOOKING_URL: Your Calendly profile URL e.g. https://calendly.com/your-handle
_setupNotes.SMTP_CREDENTIAL_ID: Set up SMTP credential in n8n Credentials. Use SendGrid or Gmail SMTP.
_setupNotes.SENDER_EMAIL: Update fromEmail to match your verified sending domain
